summary.headline: Judging Friendships
summary.text: Chapter 35 explains judging friendships and associates from the eleventh house, its lord, resident planets, Venus, and the part of friends. Fortunes indicate numerous and prosperous friends, malefics few and poor ones, while Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, Mercury, and the Moon signify different social types and professions.
